description: This Java source file defines the FinAccountPaymentServices class, which provides services for managing financial accounts used as payment methods within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for pre-authorization, release, capture, refund, withdrawal, deposit, and auto-replenishment of financial accounts, with detailed validation and transaction handling.

classes.name: FinAccountPaymentServices
classes.description: Provides static methods for managing financial accounts as payment methods, including authorization, capture, refund, withdrawal, deposit, and auto-replenishment services within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: finAccountPreAuth
methods.description: Performs pre-authorization of a financial account for a specified amount, validating account status, PIN, expiration, and available balance.

methods.name: finAccountReleaseAuth
methods.description: Releases (expires) a financial account authorization transaction.

methods.name: finAccountCapture
methods.description: Captures funds against a previously authorized financial account transaction.

methods.name: finAccountRefund
methods.description: Processes a refund by depositing funds into a financial account.

methods.name: finAccountWithdraw
methods.description: Withdraws funds from a financial account, ensuring sufficient balance and account validity.

methods.name: finAccountDeposit
methods.description: Deposits funds into a financial account, creating associated transactions and handling negative balances.

methods.name: finAccountReplenish
methods.description: Automatically replenishes a financial account when balance falls below a threshold, creating orders and deposits.

methods.name: getLastProductStoreId
methods.description: Retrieves the last product store ID associated with a financial account based on recent deposit transactions.

methods.name: createFinAcctPaymentTransaction
methods.description: Creates a financial account payment transaction, including payment creation, transaction record, and handling different transaction types.
